why_frozen_now: specifying the analysis after seeing the result would make it a choice about the outcome. D0's 192-seed rows do not exist yet; the 8-seed smoke is directional only and its quartile cutoff was computed within its own small sample.
classification: MECHANISM DIAGNOSTIC. None of these quantities is a gate. No PASS/FAIL verdict is produced, no threshold is defined, and nothing here can alter the frozen SPPPO_V1_NOT_CONFIRMED result.

bootstrap.why: decision points within an episode are heavily clustered -- 1,539 rows from 8 seeds have an effective sample size nearer 8 than 1,539. This is the same clustering that drove the seed-level bootstrap in Gate 0B.
bootstrap.procedure: resample the 192 seeds WITH REPLACEMENT; carry every decision point belonging to each sampled seed into the replicate; recompute the diagnostic quantity inside the replicate
bootstrap.quartile_handling: the worst-quartile cutoff is RECOMPUTED INSIDE each replicate, so the interval reflects both which seeds were drawn and where the failure-region boundary lands

Q1_is_the_failure_z0_being_closer_to_piB.quantity: fraction of pole-B decision points with margin_B_bits < 0, and its mean
Q1_is_the_failure_z0_being_closer_to_piB.reading: margin_B_bits = KL(pi_B||z0) - KL(pi_B||z1). Negative means z0 is CLOSER to pi_B than z1 is -- separation achieved but misdirected.

Q2_does_qpsi_rank_correctly_in_those_sam.quantity: P(delta_B_hat > 0.04) among decision points in the worst margin_B quartile
Q2_does_qpsi_rank_correctly_in_those_sam.with: seed-level bootstrap CI, quartile recomputed per replicate

Q3_do_the_bad_states_cluster.quantity: margin_B_bits and qpsi correct-rate by state category
Q3_do_the_bad_states_cluster.reading: clustered failures point to a specific decision class; uniform spread does not

WORDING_DISCIPLINE.if_qpsi_correct_rate_is_high_in_the_fail: The evidence favors optimization/interference over scorer misranking as the dominant failure mode.
WORDING_DISCIPLINE.why: a high correct-RATE says nothing about whether the score margin was large enough to produce a gradient that survived, and the incorrect remainder may sit at the most consequential states. Sign and magnitude are different claims.
WORDING_DISCIPLINE.if_qpsi_correctness_collapses_in_high_co: the fork swings back toward SURROGATE_FAILURE

what_this_cannot_do: re-score any gate or alter any threshold
consume new seeds -- it replays the ALREADY-SCORED 10300001..10300192 block
authorize training. SPPPO V2 remains unbuilt pending the fork outcome.
